sloka: यक्षाणां तु प्रहस्तेन सहस्रं निहतं रणे ।महोदरेण चानिन्द्यं सहस्रमपरं हतम् ।। ७.१५.७ ॥
transliteration: yakṣāṇāṁ tu prahastena sahasraṁ nihataṁ raṇe ।mahodareṇa cānindyaṁ sahasramaparaṁ hatam ।। 7.15.7 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, a thousand Yakshas were slain in battle by Prahasta, and another thousand blameless (excellent) Yaksha warriors were slain by Mahodara.
